shape.schedule: no central timer and no central instance: each chat runs vps-tidy from its own loop or hooks, and a maintainer never runs it for another chat. Old timers and cron lines still retire: disable, archive, 7-day undo. Nothing is scheduled by this PR
shape.lock: one flock so two runs never overlap
shape.setup_step: vps-tidy ships a '## Set up your own check' step naming the chat loop or hook that calls it, and refuses a run it cannot attribute to a calling session
shape.cross_tool: vps-state reads vps-tidy's status file and prints it; vps-tidy never prints a verdict
